appliedUpdates.description: Documented that daemon/gateway raw-path validation must use an isolated repo-built daemon instead of the shared 127.0.0.1:7788 listener because the shared installed hackd can be stale relative to the current branch.

Documented isolated offline CLI validator setup: keep projects.json beside HACK_GLOBAL_CONFIG_PATH and unset TMUX while setting TMUX_TMPDIR so session/status flows stay inside the temp validation namespace.
